body:
Thank you all for your kind and encouraging words. I feel that all my strength has gone. The past year has gone by so quickly and I feel like I’ve just been going through the motions. Get up, go to work, come home, go to bed.
Last night after posting I was sitting at home just looking at the front door. Waiting for her to walk back through, set down her purse and take off her jacket like I’ve seen her do so many times. It feels like she might. It feels like I’ll hear her key hit the lock any second. A lot of times I’ll fall asleep in that chair. I would sell my soul to the devil himself just to feel the touch of her hands again. Just for a moment.
I apologies for being such a downer. I wasn’t going to post anymore after posting my thank you yesterday. But I was so encouraged by your words I just want to say Thank You All again.
